_meta.coverage_metric: publication-policy composition, exact-head subject separation, Intent-Bound Stack graph closure, no-push background invariant, and billing-circuit fail-closed controls; checked-in repository profile key admission and Human-owned Worker surface
_meta.purpose: Prove that the Git Town Worker cannot invent branch dependencies, reuse stale child evidence, overlap active sibling path leases, create convergence early, bypass the canonical github-delivery-loop publication boundary, or collapse local sync, publication, trusted CI, and Human Admit into one green state.

runnable.hollow_mutations: selftest mutations removing no-push, billing-open, one intent, one evidence lane, or the policy composition link
covers: SYSTEM_PROMPT plus PUBLICATION_POLICY composition is mandatory for GitHub publication
repository profile names the canonical github-delivery-loop gate and exact schemas
background synchronization remains no-push
only initial-pr, ready-for-review and batched-repair are admitted
billing-open blocks publication until owner recovery
local sync, local verification, publication, trusted check and Human Admit remain separate lanes
runnable.expected: canonical files PASS; each planted hollow mutation exits non-zero with a stable contract error

runnable.hollow_mutations: wrong PR base, stale parent, wrong merge base, old receipt, prose-only fake child, missing parent dependency, sibling edge, path overlap, early convergence, ancestry cycle, or missing Human-owned operation
covers: GTSP-04 branch ancestry equals the declared proof dependency graph
GTSP-06 active sibling path leases remain disjoint
GTSP-13 merge base and observed parent equal the exact declared parent head
GTSP-14 parent or head movement invalidates old child evidence
GTSP-18 receipts bind the exact branch head
child branches consume a declared contract or byte path instead of prose-only scheduling preference
convergence remains NOT_CREATED until all prerequisites are ADMITTED
semantic conflict, merge or ship, permission widening, promotion, and destructive rollback remain Human-owned
runnable.expected: canonical fixture and Intent-Bound contract PASS; every planted graph, freshness, lease, convergence, or Human-boundary mutation exits non-zero

runnable.hollow_mutations: a misspelled key that git-town silently ignores, an unknown section, a mutable trunk selector, a trunk disagreeing with the default branch, perennials omitted or repeating the trunk, auto-resolve or push-branches or tags left enabled, an absent profile or reference, a reference missing a required section, and a Worker surface exposing ship or force push
covers: every key must be one observed taking effect against the admitted 24.0.0 binary, because an unrecognised key is ignored and reads as a setting in force
the trunk must name one immutable branch equal to the repository default branch
perennials must be declared, and an empty list is a declaration distinct from omission
auto-resolve, push-branches and tags must each be off, overriding Git Town's on-by-default
the profile reference must declare lease roots, publication gate state, and what the profile does not enforce
git-town ship and force push must not appear in an executable position in the Worker
runnable.expected: canonical profile validated; 16 planted defects refused; absent repository root exits 64
